title: Source dependency scanning
responsibility: Extracts module references and source-recorded HTTP requests from scripts, Svelte and CSS.

inputs.name: httpReferences.code
inputs.description: Source text parsed as TSX to find calls to the bare fetch identifier or event/window/globalThis/self.fetch. Other objects' fetch methods are ignored, and computed or missing arguments produce a null specifier with a call snippet.

inputs.name: scanImports.code
inputs.description: Source text whose references are selected by language. TypeScript scans imports, reexports, relative new URL references, import()/require() calls, and recognized fetch calls; Svelte scans script blocks and recognized <hx-...> atoms, CSS scans quoted @import, and other returns an empty array.

inputs.name: scanImports.language
inputs.description: Selects the scan branch: ts scans script references, svelte scans script blocks and recognized <hx-...> atoms, css scans quoted @import references, and other returns no references. These are the only accepted values.

inputs.name: svelteScripts.code
inputs.description: Svelte source text searched for <script ...>...</script> blocks. A regular expression extracts each matched body in source order and does not parse scripts structurally.

outputs.name: scanImports
outputs.description: For ts, the array contains unique references ordered by source offset; css returns quoted @import matches, and svelte returns script references followed by recognized <hx-...> atom imports. Unresolved import(), require(), or fetch arguments have a null specifier and detail, while other returns an empty array.

outputs.name: svelteScripts
outputs.description: An array of captured bodies for script tags matched by the regular expression, in source order, with the tags excluded. Non-matching tags are omitted.

outputs.name: httpReferences
outputs.description: An array of platform fetch call records in traversal order, each with its source offset, via='http', typeOnly=false, and a string specifier or null. A null specifier adds a call-text detail truncated to 120 characters.
